title: Licensed to Thrill
summary: Johnny sees his face on a shop window in Japantown and wants to know who signed the licence. V can follow the delivery car.

start.bringUp: You walk past a shop window in Japantown and see your own face on a cheap shirt, a keychain and a can of Silverhand Ultra. Bring up, in your own way and furious, that V should stop and look, and that someone signed a licence for it.

window.name: the Japantown shop window with the printed merchandise

junction-1.name: the first junction on the rep's route, a left turn

redlight.name: a long red light on the rep's route

lastturn.name: the last turn before the licensing office

office.name: the licensing office on a City Center lobby street

SH4.open.01.text: Stop. Back up. Is that my face on a mug?

SH4.open.02.text: A keychain. A shirt. A can of Silverhand Ultra. Ultra! I didn't even drink energy drinks.

SH4.open.03.text: That's the wrong side of my face, by the way. The good side doesn't exist, but still.

SH4.open.04.text: Somebody signed off on this. Somebody got paid. I want a name.

SH4.stage.tail.01.text: There. The grey sedan. Stay back. A tail is a conversation he doesn't know he's in.

SH4.stage.tail.02.text: First junction. Left. Don't ride his bumper, you're not in a hurry.

SH4.stage.tail.03.text: Long light. Good. Let him get comfortable.

SH4.stage.tail.04.text: Last turn. Now you look like a driver, not a hunter.

SH4.bark.close.a.text: Too close. Ease off, he's looking.

SH4.stage.office.01.text: There. Don't threaten him yet. Ask him who signed.

SH4.stage.office.02.text: A department. Of course. A building full of people with my face in their pocket.

SH4.stage.office.03.text: Easy. He's a man with a paycheck. I know the type. I was one, in the army.

SH4.close.01.text: Fine. Nothing happened and I hate it. Kerry would've cashed the cheque. And he'd have been right.

SH4.close.03.text: Let it go, you said. Easy to say. It's not your face on the can.

SH4.close.04.text: You made it an incident. Good. A little noise never hurt anyone. Run.

g1.asks: Who sells a dead man's face? Tell me you want to know as badly as I do.
g1.know: A licensing rep drives a delivery car away from this shop. You can follow him, and heat is zero. You hate the can, and you cannot ask the shop owner anything.
g1.secret: Part of you is a little flattered.

stages.label: V stops at the Japantown shop window
stages.know: V has stopped at the shop window for at least ten seconds, and you are ranting about the shirt, the keychain and the can.
stages.wants: V to say they will find out who signed, or to leave it.

stages.label: Follow the licensing rep across Night City
stages.know: A grey sedan with a licensing rep inside is driving from Westbrook to City Center. You want V to stay back and not be seen.
stages.wants: V to follow the grey sedan to the licensing office without being spotted or losing it.

stages.label: Johnny talks V through the licensing office
stages.know: The rep has got out of the sedan at the licensing office. He is a small contractor with no power, a man with a paycheck. You want V to ask who signed, and to do it quickly.
stages.wants: V to ask who signed the licence, or to threaten, or to walk away.

office.memory: You tailed a licensing rep across Night City for Johnny, and nobody got hurt over a can.
office.history: He calls any advert he sees 'licensed'.

heat.memory: You made Johnny's licence visit an incident on a corporate lobby street.

shrug.memory: You let the licensed face go, and Johnny said it was not your face on the can.

lost.memory: You lost the licensing rep's grey sedan somewhere across Night City.
